rows.grounds: gloss 'pair+swallowing'; grāsāt = m.abl.sg of grāsa (swallowing) indicating source/removal by swallowing the pair (centre-between-opposites context).
gloss 'without-interval'; nir- + avakāśa = no interval/space; state/quality in nom.sg (doctrine: opening/consuming into interval-free centre).
gloss 'consciousness+abiding'; saṃvit (consciousness) + niṣṭhā (abiding/settling), f.nom.sg; abiding in consciousness (mahāsāhasa/centre consummation).
